what: One model, one run of the Slice 2 definition-of-done turn (tests/e2e/tests/07-tool-loop.spec.ts: 'create a file called groceries.md with five items, then read it back and confirm'), on the GPU, recorded per model. Data only — no conclusions, no tier changes; that is a later decision and this file is its input.

how.stack: compose project nova-e2e (deploy/docker-compose.yml + tests/e2e/docker-compose.isolated.yml + tests/e2e/docker-compose.isolated-gpu.yml), no published host ports, volumes nova-e2e_*
how.host: one NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090, 24576 MiB total; ollama 0.33.1 reported 22.8 GiB available at startup
how.gpu_precondition: the other stack's ollama (127.0.0.1:11434) reported {"models":[]} on a read-only GET immediately before each load, and again after the last turn
how.load_s: wall time of POST /api/generate {prompt: "", keep_alive: "20m"} against the isolated ollama, from an empty /api/ps
how.wall_s: turns.ended_at - turns.started_at for the turn the scenario produced, out of the core ledger
how.rounds: count of kind='llm_call' spans on that turn
how.tool_calls: count of kind='tool' spans on that turn
how.vram_mb: size_vram for the model in the isolated ollama's /api/ps, after the load
how.context_length: as reported by the isolated ollama's /api/ps for the loaded model

models.notes: Scenario 07 passed. Both tool calls succeeded on the first attempt; the write and the read were issued in the same round. Round 1 was 42.7s of the 45.5s turn. The reply's five items were Oat Milk, Eggs, Bread, Apples, Banana.

Scenario 07 passed. The model loaded fully into VRAM (size_vram == size) at the default 32768 context, on a card whose reported free memory at ollama startup was 22.8 GiB. tests/e2e/README.md records an earlier occasion on this same box where a runner for this slug could not be started at all; the desktop was holding about 7.5 GiB then. One tool call per round: write in round 1, read in round 2, final text in round 3.

cpu_reference.where: the same isolated stack with the GPU reservation removed (tests/e2e/docker-compose.isolated.yml), CPU only
cpu_reference.scenarios: 10 files, 12 tests, from a first-run instance including the 1.4 GB model pull
cpu_reference.notes: Included because the functional walk runs here by design and these are the same scenario's numbers under the configuration the suite defaults to. Not measured with the load/VRAM instrumentation above.

prompt_growth.method: reconstructed inside the core container with core's own app.chat.base_messages / completion_payload / history_window over the rows and spans each turn actually used; the recall snippet text is the one thing not accounted (both turns recorded hits=1, so each round's real body is one snippet larger than the number below)
